jobs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. EDIT TARGET image1: the existing Bastion left-facing 8-figure walk sheet. Image2 is the authoritative original FRONT character, body build, costume and proportions. Image3 is its actual native64 front rendering, authoritative for relative head/body/boots sizes.
Primary change: fix the inflated stocky appearance of the lateral sheet so turning into it looks like THE SAME SIZE AND BUILD as the front character. Redraw the whole figures with image2's anatomy and outfit proportions, keeping image1's exact walking poses, order, compact support changes, direction, layout and costume identity. The current image1 has an oversized head, thick chest, chunky biceps, enormous gloves and boots relative to the native front. Reduce those inflated masses naturally through drawing. Keep the original athletic adult silhouette; small head, natural narrow waist, normal hands/boots, original leg length. Project the SAME physique into front-three-quarter LEFT, with both shoulders visible. A three-quarter torso should appear a little NARROWER than the front, not wider. Do not simply squeeze the bitmap horizontally and do not make a tiny dwarf or a large-headed chibi. No added muscles, padding, armor, cape or design.
Invariants: preserve dark short-sleeve shirt and charcoal sleeveless tactical vest with copper shoulder fasteners, exposed forearms, olive cargo trousers, dark gloves and boots, brown short hair/stubble. Exact same face identity and head-to-height ratio as image2. Preserve six walking leg poses of image1, including visibly bent swing knee, raised trailing heel and alternating anatomical support leg; no leg spreading, jogging, high kicks or stationary shuffle. All head/torso/knees/boots face screen LEFT in all8 cells. Complete relaxed arms, closed empty fists, no equipped weapon (weapon layer attaches later). No disconnected arms, holes or extra limbs.
Output exactly 4 columns by2 rows, eight complete isolated whole figures in this row-major order: true both-feet-grounded idle, walk0, walk1, walk2, walk3, walk4, walk5, duplicate idle. Consistent whole-figure scale, head size and body proportions in every cell, equal foot baseline. Keep the four-by-two grid with generous transparent margins and no clipped soles/head. Pixel-friendly painted game sprites matching the original front artwork's detail and shading, controlled dark outline. Transparent alpha background, no labels, text, visible grid, ground shadow or effects.
